title: Liquid time-constant networks
summary: A neuron whose reaction speed is set by its input: drag the input and watch the time constant move, see why the state can't escape its bounds, step the fused solver, and compare the paper's trajectory lengths and benchmarks.

source.label: Hasani, Lechner, Amini, Rus, Grosu, Liquid Time-constant Networks, AAAI 2021
